title: Multi-host local Ollama inference
description: Allow multiple LAN-connected computers to each host their own Ollama instance and route selected inference requests from the Local AI gateway or supervisor to those instances.
possible_value: Optional additional local compute, ability to use different hardware/models and possible greater throughput or resilience.
key_future_questions: Topology, Bifrost OSS support/adapter compatibility, model availability and naming, network permissions, routing/load balancing, resource monitoring, failure recovery, checkpoint ownership, authentication and whether any additional nodes hold user data.

title: Atomic Open WebUI final-result delivery
description: Conditionally update the original assistant acknowledgement inside one transaction so a concurrent edit or deletion is preserved.
possible_value: Eliminate the race between checking the acknowledgement and writing the final result.
key_future_questions: Check for upstream support first. If a version-pinned patch is needed, retain reproducible application and rollback instructions and verify concurrent edit and deletion cases.
